$comment: Real easing curves and named CSS keyframe animations from tailwind.config.js and src/index.css, plus the full site-wide motion inventory from CLONE_SPEC.md §17. This is the closed, evidence-grounded set of motion primitives available to any section's motion contract — nothing outside this list.
measuredFrom: tailwind.config.js:133-160 (transitionTimingFunction, keyframes, animation); src/index.css (marquee/shimmer/caret-blink rules); CLONE_SPEC.md:311-334 (§17 Motion inventory, complete)

out.usedFor: the default UI easing — nearly every load/hover/click animation on the site

in-out.usedFor: agent stepper track translateY, tile background-color transition

default.usedFor: Tailwind's default transition-colors (nav item dim, footer link dim)

reducedMotion.$comment: Every animation on the real site has a documented prefers-reduced-motion branch. A generated section MUST declare its reducedMotionFallback field per the schema; leaving it implicit is a real accessibility regression on this site, not just a nice-to-have.
reducedMotion.rule: elements shown immediately (final state, no transition), marquee/shimmer animation-play-state paused or removed, typing caret hidden
reducedMotion.measuredFrom: CLONE_SPEC.md:14 ("every animation has a reduced-motion branch"); src/index.css (prefers-reduced-motion block disabling .animate-marquee/.animate-shimmer/.prompt-caret)

siteWideInventory.$comment: The complete, closed list of every real motion pattern observed on the live site (CLONE_SPEC.md §17, verbatim table). Section motion contracts must reference an id from this list, or a page/product-family-specific extension documented in specs/SPEC_product.md §11 or specs/SPEC_persona_company.md's motion inventory — never an invented pattern.

patterns.property: track y -rowHeight; row opacities shift; active tile bg->ink
bg, img scale 1.04, indicator scale 1.1 + icon rotate 90deg + color invert
overlay opacity; li opacity + y 8px stagger; hamburger->X

explicitlyExcluded.$comment: Real constraints confirmed by direct measurement, not assumptions — a generated section must NOT invent any of these.
excludes: sticky elements (header included — it scrolls away)
